surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; extremely soft gradient transitions between the primary white dorsal surface and the slightly darker lateral shading.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A distinct longitudinal ridge is visible along the posterior central axis, creating a sharp geometric peak in the 2D plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Healed linear marks of varying lengths distributed across the dorsal surface, likely resulting from past physical interactions.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, high-contrast dark circular aperture representing the blowhole at the anterior end of the visible dorsal area.
